# var2clipb

Copies the text data to clipboard. *(version 4.46 or later)*

```ttl
var2clipb <string>
```

## Remarks

Copies &lt;string&gt; to clipboard.
The "var2clipb" command returns one of the following values in the system variable "result":

<table>
 <tr>
  <th>Value</th>
  <th>Meaning</th>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>0</td>
  <td>Could not open the clipboard.</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>1</td>
  <td>Copying to clipboard is successful.</td>
 </tr>
</table>

## Example

```ttl
var2clipb 'Tera Term 4.46'
clipb2var data
messagebox data 'clipboard data'
```
